title: v1_124 / Editor Experience
content:
## Editor Experience

### Create folder when opening folder from simple file dialog

When you are opening a folder from the simple file dialog (`setting(files.simpleDialog.enable:true)`), you can now create a new folder directly from the dialog by typing the name of the folder you want to create and pressing `kbstyle(Enter)` or selecting **OK**.

### Integrated Browser

#### History

**Setting**: `setting(workbench.browser.maxHistoryEntries)`

The integrated browser now retains the history of visited pages. History items are surfaced as suggestions when typing in the URL bar, and can be managed using `kb(workbench.action.browser.showHistory)` from within a browser tab. The maximum number of history items to remember can be adjusted via `setting(workbench.browser.maxHistoryEntries)`.

![Screenshot showing the URL bar in the integrated browser, with an input of "Wiki" showing several Wikipedia pages from history.](images/1_124/browser-history.webp)

#### Improved toolbar customizability

Previously, **Add Element to Chat** and **Toggle Developer Tools** were the only actions that could be made persistently visible in the right side of the browser toolbar.

Now, all actions that appear within the overflow menu can also be surfaced persistently by right-clicking on the toolbar area to the right of the URL input:

![Screenshot showing the context menu allowing the user to toggle visible menu items.](images/1_124/browser-toolbar.webp)

#### Faster agentic text entry

Previously, typing text and pressing `kbstyle(Enter)` required two separate tool calls. Now, the `typeInPage` tool supports a `submit` parameter to allow agents to type text and press Enter in one tool call.

This reduces round-trips for common text-entry scenarios.

![Screenshot showing a tool call where the agent typed text into a page and pressed enter.](images/1_124/browser-type-tool.webp)
